scenes.name: top-frame_riso
scenes.probe: (() => { const box = (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [r.x, r.y, r.width, r.height]; }; const lines = [...document.querySelectorAll('.view-overlays .debug-top-stack-frame-line, .view-overlays .debug-focused-stack-frame-line')]; return lines.map((l) => ({ class: l.className, color: getComputedStyle(l).backgroundColor, under: [...l.parentElement.children].map((c) => c.className), box: box(l) })); })()
